findings.area: unreleased AzGuard bridge must not gate access CI
findings.scenario: auth-tests, packages-tests, and quality all start with a root composer update. Root require-dev includes axiomasoft/corex-access-azguard and axioma-studio/azguard-core, and the only source is the package repository https://github.com/axiomasoft/azguard-private.git. The workflow sets persist-credentials false and declares no secret or token. On a runner that cannot clone that private repository, composer update fails before the access test, test:packages, analyse, and lint steps.
findings.evidence: composer.json:46-47 and :110-120; .github/workflows/ci.yml:640-641, :652-668, :766-782, :960-979; checkout persist-credentials false at ci.yml:632; no secret or COMPOSER_AUTH in ci.yml; P07-design.md failure F6 requires a secret-gated bridge job and says access must keep running.

findings.area: AzGuard permission cache discriminator with no workspace
findings.scenario: The bridge binds WorkspacePermissionLayer by default. AzGuard EffectivePermissionResolver::forUser calls cacheDiscriminator before any grant source. Boxed SingleAccountResolver returns a TenantContext whose workspace is null, and TenancyManager::setWorkspace(null) is a supported account-scoped context. context() is then non-null, so context()?->workspace->id reads id on null and throws Error. Every AzGuard permission lookup in that context aborts, including the null-safe path in AutMatrixGrantSource.
findings.evidence: WorkspacePermissionLayer.php:37; SingleAccountResolver.php:28-36 (workspace: null, boxed: true); NullTenancyManager.php:28-31; TenancyManager.php:43-46; EffectivePermissionResolver.php:57-61; AutMatrixGrantSource.php:60 uses context()?->workspace?->id; AccessAzguardBindingsRegistrar.php:33-35 binds the layer when bind_permission_layer defaults to true.
